name: Chris Riopelle
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Strive Health (Denver value-based kidney-care company)
profile: Healthcare operator who co-founded Strive Health in 2018 and leads it as CEO; Strive partners with health plans and nephrologists to manage chronic kidney disease and dialysis under value-based contracts and is valued ~$2B. Previously held senior executive roles at GeriMed, Gambro, DaVita, LaVie Care Centers and NorthStar Anesthesia.
interesting_fact: Named a Most Admired CEO by the Denver Business Journal and an EY Entrepreneur of the Year.
deep_cut_fact: Holds a BA in economics from Albion College and a JD/MBA from the University of Detroit Mercy; outside work he sits on the board of the Crested Butte Land Trust (Colorado conservation) and enjoys boating, biking and skiing.

public_contacts.value: nleatherman@strivehealth.com (Strive Director of Communications & PR, published media contact)

notes: Strive's public face; best route is the Strive comms lead. Strive also offers a media kit on its newsroom page.

name: Karri Saarinen
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Linear (Linear Orbit, Inc., San Francisco)
profile: Finnish designer-founder who left his Principal Designer role at Airbnb in 2019 to start Linear with Jori Lallo and Tuomas Artman. Linear's issue-tracking/product-development tool became a favourite of startups, was cash-flow positive by 2021, and an Aug 2026 tender valued it at $2.5B. He writes widely on design, quality and AI-era software.
interesting_fact: Linear began from a Chrome extension he wrote at Airbnb to tame JIRA's visual noise; about 100 Airbnb colleagues ended up using it.
deep_cut_fact: As Design Lead on Airbnb's Design Language System team he helped roll out the Airbnb Cereal typeface (made with Dalton Maag) in 2018, and earlier designed at Coinbase. Before Linear, he and Jori Lallo built a startup in Y Combinator's Summer 2012 batch. He's a fan of 'Jiro Dreams of Sushi' as a lesson in taste.
notes: Very accessible publicly: personal blog plus a long interviews list (YC, First Round, TBPN, Figma Config) at karrisaarinen.com/interviews. Good podcast candidate.

name: Steve Winn
current_role: Founder & backer of Cosm (immersive 'shared reality' venues); sole manager/president of Mirasol Capital (his Dallas family office)
profile: Stephen T. Winn is the Dallas entrepreneur who led RealPage (property-management software) as CEO from 1998 until its 2021 sale to Thoma Bravo. Through his family office Mirasol Capital he created Cosm in 2020, buying planetarium-tech pioneer Evans & Sutherland and Spitz; Cosm now runs dome venues showing live sports in LA, Dallas, Atlanta and Detroit.
interesting_fact: Cosm grew out of his 2020 purchase of Evans & Sutherland, the 1968 computer-graphics pioneer founded by Ivan Sutherland and David Evans, for about $14.5M.
deep_cut_fact: Long before RealPage he ran Computer Language Research Inc., a tax-compliance and accounting software company, as President & CEO from 1969 to 1998 (later sold to Thomson Reuters). He holds a BS in electrical engineering from UT Austin and an MS in management science from Stanford.
notes: Identity link: SEC 13D for the E&S deal (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276283/000110465920022795/a20-9351_2sc13d.htm) shows Stephen T. Winn controlling Mirasol/Elevate (Cosm) and Seren Capital; RealPage's 2021 merger proxy shows the same Seren Capital holding his RealPage shares. Private; Cosm CEO Jeb Terry is the usual spokesman. Avoid RealPage antitrust litigation topics.
